package main
import("bytes";"encoding/json";"github.com/charmbracelet/colorprofile";"serviceunlock/internal/render";"context";"errors";"fmt";"net/http";"os";"path/filepath";"strings";"testing";"time";"serviceunlock/internal/extra")
func TestTaskGukoFixtures(t *testing.T){
 for _,tc:=range []struct{name,country string;allUnknown,deny bool}{{"global-failed","",false,false},{"global-unsupported","CN",false,false},{"jp","JP",false,false},{"jp-denied","JP",false,true},{"na","US",false,false},{"eu","DE",false,false},{"sea","SG",false,false},{"hk","HK",false,false},{"tw","TW",false,false},{"kr","KR",false,false},{"sa","BR",false,false},{"oc","AU",false,false},{"af","ZA",false,false},{"jp-unknown","JP",true,false},{"global-no-route","",false,false},{"jp-ipv6","JP",false,false},{"sea-fallback","SG",false,false}}{
  var out,stderr bytes.Buffer;var measured measurements
  code:=runCLI(context.Background(),[]string{"--machine"},&out,&stderr,func(ctx context.Context,timeout time.Duration,workers int)(measurements,error){
   stack,_:=mockCompleteStack(t);original:=stack.HTTP(0).Transport
   stack.HTTP(0).Transport=autoTrip(func(r *http.Request)(*http.Response,error){if tc.allUnknown{return nil,errors.New("OFFLINE MOCK network unavailable")};if r.URL.Hostname()=="spclient.wg.spotify.com"{body:=`{"status":311,"country":"JP","is_country_launched":true,"errors":{"email":"Required","password":"Required"}}`;if tc.deny{body=`{"status":320,"errors":{"generic_error":"You seem to be using a proxy service. Please turn off these services and try again. For more help, please contact customer service."},"push-notifications":false}`};return autoResponse(r,200,body),nil};return original.RoundTrip(r)})
   family:=4;if tc.name=="jp-ipv6"{family=6};client:=extra.NewClient(family,timeout);defer client.Close();client.HTTP.Transport=autoTrip(func(r *http.Request)(*http.Response,error){if r.URL.String()==extra.CountryTraceURL{if tc.country==""||tc.name=="sea-fallback"{return autoResponse(r,500,"unavailable"),nil};return autoResponse(r,200,"h=www.cloudflare.com\nloc="+tc.country+"\n"),nil};if r.URL.String()==extra.CountryFallbackURL{if tc.name=="sea-fallback"{return autoResponse(r,200,`{"country_code":"SG"}`),nil};return autoResponse(r,500,"unavailable"),nil};if !tc.allUnknown&&strings.Contains(r.URL.Hostname(),"tvbanywhere"){return autoResponse(r,200,`{"allow_in_this_country":true}`),nil};return nil,errors.New("OFFLINE MOCK service unavailable")})
   if tc.name=="global-no-route"{client.Family=0;m,e:=runWithClients(ctx,workers,stack,client,errors.New("no local route"));measured=m;return m,e};m,e:=runWithClients(ctx,workers,stack,client,nil);measured=m;return m,e
  });if tc.name=="jp" {var env struct{Format string `json:"format"`;Report report `json:"report"`;Terminal string `json:"terminal"`};if e:=json.Unmarshal(out.Bytes(),&env);e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)};var b bytes.Buffer;b.WriteString(selectionNotice(env.Report.Selection)+"\n");profile:=colorprofile.NewWriter(&b,nil);profile.Profile=colorprofile.TrueColor;terminal:=render.NewMachineOutput(profile);terminal.Width=40;if e:=terminal.PrintAccess(render.Report{Access:measured.Access,Services:measured.Services,AI:measured.AI,Extra:measured.Extra,Region:resolvedRegion(measured.Selection)});e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)};env.Terminal=b.String();body,e:=json.Marshal(env);if e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)};os.MkdirAll(os.Getenv("GUKO_FIXTURE_DIR"),0755);if e=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("GUKO_FIXTURE_DIR"),"jp-narrow.json"),body,0644);e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)}};if code!=1||stderr.Len()!=0{t.Fatal(tc.name,code,stderr.String())};root:=os.Getenv("GUKO_FIXTURE_DIR");os.MkdirAll(root,0755);if e:=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root,tc.name+".json"),out.Bytes(),0644);e!=nil{t.Fatal(e)};fmt.Println(tc.name,"OFFLINE MOCK actual CLI pipeline")
 }
}
